backgrounds.title: 曜火研究室
backgrounds.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: reusable empty background plate for a layered visual novel game. Image 1 is a style/environment reference and edit target. A completely unoccupied gothic crystal research laboratory inspired by the reference. Cool blue tall lancet windows, dark bookcases, old brass crystal measurement equipment and quiet amber lamps. Put a low empty workbench and equipment in the MIDGROUND/BACKGROUND, leave the lower third open dark stone floor and the central foreground empty. The crystal contains only a small soft light, no imagery. Remove EVERY person from the reference, including all faces, hands, silhouettes, figures, reflections, and the person-shaped apparition inside the crystal. No prominent objects blocking the left or right foreground. Preserve the semi-realistic dark fantasy illustration style, antique brass and aged gold materials, muted green-black and cold blue night palette, realistic stone and subtle atmosphere. Landscape 16:9 composition. Low contrast and uncluttered foreground; enough architectural depth to place transparent character art in front. Absolutely no people, human parts, creatures, ghosts, portraits, statues, face shapes, written text, captions, readable symbols, UI, frame, watermark. A clean background environment only.
backgrounds.visualQA: Inspected generated output: empty environment, no people or body fragments; clear foreground for compositing.
